gloss_en: Atik (the Ancient One) — the kabbalistic partzuf Atik/Atik Yomin, the most ancient and concealed divine countenance, associated in Likutey Moharan 60 with the elder (zaken), abundant kindness (rav chesed), and the stories of ancient years from which all seventy faces/years receive vitality; not the ordinary adjective עתיק 'old/ancient thing' nor עתיק 'copied/removed'
